findings.rule: Heat treatment field must not contradict or omit a referenced heat-treatment note.
findings.reasoning: The title block heat_treatment field is '---' (none specified), yet note N1 explicitly requires through hardening to 50 HRC. A manufacturer reading only the title block will skip heat treatment entirely, producing a soft part that fails in service.
findings.correction: Update the title block heat_treatment field to reference N1 (e.g., 'AS PER NOTE N1') or state 'THROUGH HARDENED 50 HRC' directly.

findings.rule: Specified hardness must be achievable for the given material and process.
findings.reasoning: Material 20MnCr5 is a low-carbon case-hardening steel (~0.2% C). Note N1 calls for 'through hardening up to 50 HRC', but this carbon content cannot achieve 50 HRC even with severe quenching; through-hardening is the wrong process for this alloy. The correct treatment is carburize and harden to obtain a hard case with a tough core.
findings.correction: Change N1 to specify carburizing (e.g., 'CARBURIZE AND HARDEN, CASE DEPTH x–y mm, SURFACE HARDNESS 58–62 HRC') or change the material to a medium/high-carbon or alloy steel suitable for through hardening to 50 HRC.

findings.rule: Functional bores on mating parts require a tolerance or fit class to control assembly.
findings.reasoning: Dimensions D4 and D12 define a ⌀20 inner bore (feature F2) of a pin sleeve with no tolerance. As a functional mating diameter, an untoleranced bore leaves the fit undefined and risks improper assembly or excessive play.
findings.correction: Add an appropriate tolerance or fit class to the ⌀20 bore (e.g., H7 or a specific ± tolerance) based on the mating pin's requirements.

findings.rule: Functional outer diameters on mating parts require a tolerance or fit class.
findings.reasoning: Dimensions D1 and D13 define the ⌀30 outer cylindrical surface (feature F1) with no tolerance. If this OD locates or fits into another component, the lack of tolerance compromises design intent and assembly.
findings.correction: Assign a suitable tolerance or fit class to the ⌀30 outer diameter consistent with its function in the assembly.
